PaletteSwatchDto.description: One swatch as the popover shows it.

holder.description: The workspace holding it, if another does: a pick asks to swap.

initials.description: The holder's initials, as the swatch shows them.

key.description:
What `workspace.colour.popover`'s pick names it by: a preset's
lower-case name, or `last_custom`.

name.description: The words under it: the preset's name or the custom `#RRGGBB`.

WorkspaceColourDto.description:
A workspace's colour as the wire reads it: a preset names itself and its
index (`{"preset": "sky", "index": 2, ...}`), a custom colour its hex
(`{"custom": "#3A7BD5", ...}`); both give the value painted in each theme.
No two workspaces hold identical colours (`workspace.colour.set`).

custom.description: The custom colour's `#RRGGBB`; absent on a preset.

index.description: The preset's place in the palette, as files store it.

preset.description: The preset's name in lower case; absent on a custom colour.

description:
The palette the header swatch opens: the sixteen presets, who holds
each, the last custom colour and the colour a new workspace would take.

last_custom.description: The seventeenth swatch: the last custom colour applied, once one was.

title: WorkspaceColourPaletteResult
